title: Decline of the Digital Binary Ancients — source and continuity review
authorDirection: Era Zero is the great prosperity. Center decline in Era One; preserve late Era Zero warnings without recasting the entire flourishing as disguised collapse.
scope: Expanded timeline paragraphs 350–682; major-player entries for Firstless Coalitions, Auditors, Num bureaucracy, Reciprocity, Archive Castes, Full Speakers, Composite Minds, Reductionists, Continuationists and small awakenings; primary First Silenced Chord passages; shared conversation; research below. No exhaustive recovery of historical chats is claimed.
decisions: Retain the established era names and the five Era Zero ages and seven Era One periods.
Do not adopt the draft's 12,000-cycle BPR calendar or illustrative 15/35/60/85 percent maintenance figures as measurements.
Preserve the Final Era Zero Assembly's recognition of the problem. Limited recognition, denial and desperation are overlapping responses, not replacement eras.
Locate the major maintenance and complexity crisis chiefly in Era One, particularly the Complexity Race.
Use Concordance Network as the established network. Great Network and computational highways remain development imagery.
Recast Great Highway Crisis / Great Recursion as proposed Interchange Cascade, placed within Era One and distinct from Proof of Recurrence.
Retain ordinary life's value, local novelty, uncertainty about model limits, and num as transformation of developmental capacity.
Distinguish Witness Fatigue from boredom, and Thinning of the Self from merely shared tastes.
Do not claim total disappearance of extinction, disagreement, discovery or local culture.
Treat the First Silenced Chord's timeline account and primary story as source perspectives; preserve archived data, instructional withdrawal and Nemi's reduced living form.
Keep Full Speech ternary architecture and runtime state 2 distinct from num; add no language roots or executable grammar.
Do not turn Reduction into efficiency optimization, the Codex into a ruler, or cyber-pets into dormant ancient personalities.
Preserve all fifteen original warning-sign proposals in an assessment table; label eight new connective incidents and archaeological scenes as proposed fiction.
